description: Shopify is a leading e-commerce platform that enables businesses of all sizes to create online stores, sell products, and manage their business operations.
target_market: Entrepreneurs, small businesses, and enterprises looking to establish or scale their online presence

key_features.description: Intuitive tools to create professional online stores without coding knowledge
Beautiful, responsive themes that can be customized to match brand identity
Built-in payment gateway and support for multiple payment providers
Comprehensive tools to track and manage product inventory
Built-in SEO, email marketing, and social media integration
Real-time insights into sales, traffic, and customer behavior
